network_help: Select the local IPv4 address explicitly. The calculated subnet broadcast can be entered below; directed broadcast and unicast targets are supported. Cross-subnet completeness is not implied.
bindAddress_help: Address of the interface on which the BACnet UDP socket is bound.
broadcastAddress_help: Usually the broadcast address calculated from the selected IPv4 interface and subnet.
additionalTargets: Additional directed broadcast or unicast targets
discovery_help: Use the instance message commands startDiscovery, cancelDiscovery, getDiscoveryStatus, listDevices and importDevices from Admin or scripts. Jobs answer immediately and expose progress.
autoImportAll_help: After discovery, import every device whose instance number is unique.
covEnabled_help: Unsupported or failed COV subscriptions fall back to polling.
write_warning: BACnet writes are disabled by default. A point is writable only when global writing is enabled, its stable point ID is allowlisted, and the object/property combination is supported.
diagnostics_help: Runtime status is available below info.*. Use getDiagnostics for an anonymised report containing socket, active job, queue and counters.
